project.title: Cross-Site Quality Upgrade for New Food-Grade Facility
project.objective: Design and roll out a compliant, efficient quality system for a new food-grade production and storage facility integrating construction, operations, and supply chain.
deliverables: End-to-end quality and food safety process map for the new facility
Facility layout and construction specs aligned with quality and hygiene standards
Supplier and logistics quality requirements for inbound and outbound flows
Environmental and biological risk assessment for the site and processes
Integrated commissioning and validation plan for facility and equipment
Standard operating procedures and checklists for start-of-operations
constraints: Facility must be ready for pilot operations within 30 days
Compliance with relevant food safety and construction regulations
Limited budget for design changes after construction tender is issued
Cold-chain integrity must be maintained for all test shipments
Construction activities must minimize environmental impact on surroundings

risks.risk: Construction design conflicts with hygiene and quality flow requirements discovered late.
risks.mitigation: Run early joint design reviews and pre-approval of critical layouts by quality and operations.

risks.risk: Key suppliers cannot meet new quality and cold-chain requirements in time.
risks.mitigation: Segment suppliers by risk, prioritize audits, and define temporary controls or backup suppliers.

risks.risk: Environmental or biological hazards around the site impact approvals.
risks.mitigation: Conduct early environmental and biological assessments and integrate mitigation into design and SOPs.

risks.risk: Commissioning delays due to unclear responsibilities between construction and operations.
risks.mitigation: Create a detailed RACI and integrated commissioning schedule agreed by all teams.

themes.why_relevant: Architect and construction manager must align layout with quality and food safety flows.
Supply chain manager defines how materials move in and out while preserving quality.

themes.theme: Quality and food safety standards integration
themes.why_relevant: Food technologist and quality roles translate standards into practical procedures.
Biologist assesses site and process risks that affect approvals and operations.
All roles coordinate to ensure the facility is test-run and validated before operations.

backlog.task: Map end-to-end product and material flows for the new facility with quality control points
definition_of_done: Flow diagrams created for raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods
Critical control points and sampling points identified and documented
Flow map reviewed and agreed by supply chain manager and construction manager

backlog.task: Define supplier qualification and cold-chain requirements for inbound materials
definition_of_done: Supplier quality criteria and documentation requirements drafted
Cold-chain handling and monitoring requirements defined for each material category
Requirements shared with quality and biologist for feedback and finalized

backlog.task: Design facility layout and zoning aligned with hygiene and process flows
definition_of_done: Preliminary layout with clean/dirty zoning and personnel flows produced
Layout validated against flow map and regulatory spacing requirements
Construction manager and food technologist sign off on layout feasibility

backlog.task: Plan construction methods and schedule to meet quality and regulatory constraints
definition_of_done: Construction schedule aligned with 30-day pilot deadline created
Methods and materials list checked for compliance with food-grade standards
Risk register for construction phase drafted and shared with project team

backlog.task: Conduct environmental and biological baseline assessment of the site
definition_of_done: Sampling plan for air, water, and surrounding environment defined and executed
Report summarizing biological and environmental risks delivered
Mitigation recommendations integrated into design and SOP drafts

backlog.task: Draft core quality and food safety SOPs for production and storage
definition_of_done: SOPs for cleaning, sampling, storage, and non-conformance handling drafted
SOPs reviewed by biologist for biological risk controls
Final versions approved by quality assurance stakeholder

backlog.task: Define inbound and outbound logistics processes for the new facility
definition_of_done: Dock scheduling, loading, and unloading procedures documented
Interfaces with warehouse management and transport providers described
Processes aligned with cold-chain and hygiene SOPs

backlog.task: Detail construction specifications for food-grade surfaces and utilities
definition_of_done: Specifications for floors, walls, ceilings, and drainage documented
Utility routing (water, power, HVAC) aligned with hygiene zoning
Construction manager confirms specs are buildable within budget

backlog.task: Create integrated commissioning and validation plan
definition_of_done: List of systems and equipment requiring commissioning compiled
Test protocols and responsibilities agreed with food technologist and biologist
Commissioning timeline aligned with overall project schedule

backlog.task: Develop environmental monitoring and sampling program for operations
definition_of_done: Monitoring points and frequencies defined for key areas
Sampling and analysis methods documented and aligned with SOPs
Program reviewed and accepted by quality assurance stakeholder

backlog.task: Consolidate project risk register and mitigation tracking
definition_of_done: Risks from construction, quality, supply chain, and environment compiled
Mitigation owners and due dates assigned
Register shared and agreed by all project participants

backlog.task: Prepare go-live readiness checklist for pilot operations
definition_of_done: Checklist covers facility, process, documentation, and training items
Inputs from architect, construction manager, supply chain manager, and biologist integrated
Checklist approved by operations and quality stakeholders

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on facility layout, zoning, and construction constraints before finalizing design.
threads_plan.trigger: Architect shares updated layout draft and requests cross-functional feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the proposed layout and zoning or request specific revisions.
Confirm construction materials and finishes for food-contact and high-hygiene areas.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and agree on supplier qualification and cold-chain requirements.
threads_plan.trigger: Supply chain manager posts initial supplier requirements matrix for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on minimum quality and documentation requirements for key suppliers.
Decide on monitoring approach for cold-chain performance during pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Consolidate environmental and biological risk controls into design and SOPs.
threads_plan.trigger: Biologist shares draft risk assessment findings and mitigation proposals.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which environmental monitoring points and frequencies to adopt for go-live.
Agree on additional design or procedural changes required to mitigate key risks.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock the commissioning, validation, and pilot go-live plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Construction manager posts draft commissioning plan and readiness checklist.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the integrated commissioning schedule and responsibilities.
Confirm criteria and target date for pilot go-live readiness.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in where each role posts status, blockers, and next steps.
Weekly design and risk review thread to validate changes against quality and regulatory needs.
Commissioning countdown updates three times per week as the pilot date approaches.
Post-decision recap messages summarizing key agreements and next actions after each major thread.
